1	# State invariants
2	
3	Booking and confirmation rules are checked by model-based tests: a small reference model plus seeded random event
4	sequences, every invariant asserted after every event. A new state bug gets a new rule id here first, then a test.
5	Design context: `docs/design/design.md` §6.
6	
7	## Event alphabet
8	`quote(user, conv, origin, dest)`, `stream_done(conv)` (cards presented, nonces issued),
9	`user_message(conv, text)` (incl. negations and questions), `llm_request_booking(conv, quote)`,
10	`click_book(user, quote, nonce)`, `click_book_concurrent(user, quote, nonce)`, `replay_nonce(quote, nonce)`,
11	`clock(+Δ)`, `db_change(kind)` (leg removed / coordinate moved / unrelated row changed / file replaced),
12	`other_user_click(quote, nonce)`, `disconnect_reconnect(conv)`.
13	
14	## B. Booking
15	- **B1 Ownership.** A ticket exists only if its quote belongs to the user who clicked.
16	- **B2 Presented.** A ticket exists only if its quote reached `presented` (its full card was sent with `done`) before the click.
17	- **B3 Click only.** Every ticket is caused by exactly one `click_book` with a valid, unused nonce for that quote; no
18	  other event (in particular `llm_request_booking`, any `user_message`) ever creates a ticket.
19	- **B4 Validity.** No ticket for a quote older than 15 minutes at click time.
20	- **B5 Idempotent.** At most one ticket per quote, under replay and concurrent clicks.
21	- **B6 Fresh.** A ticket's legs, coordinates, distance and price strings equal a fresh recomputation on the
22	  `locations.db` current at click time, and the route is still the cheapest; otherwise the quote is `stale` and no ticket.
23	- **B7 Atomic.** Quote status and tickets never disagree: `booked` ⇔ exactly one ticket.
24	
25	## Q. Quotes
26	- **Q1 No supersede.** Creating a quote never changes the status of another quote.
27	- **Q2 Button state.** The button state a client sees (after `done` or reconnect) equals the server's quote state.
28	- **Q3 Terminal.** `booked`, `expired`, `stale` never change again.
29	
30	## Process
31	- Seeds are fixed in CI. A failing seed prints its shrunk sequence and is kept as a named regression case.
32	- Layers: pure model test over `airline/` → API driven with fakes (clock, LLM, locations.db copy) → UI scenario
33	  (ego-browser) for the click path.
34	# API and card contract (v1, 2026-11-23)
35	
36	Single source for the frontend (T6) and backend (T2/T3/T5). Change it only through the coordinator. Examples live in
37	`contract/fixtures/`; both sides' tests load them. Numbers in fixtures are **illustrative** (computed with a quick
38	script, not by the production core) — correctness is tested in the backend, not by these files.
39	
40	## Conventions
41	- Same origin, JSON, paths under `/api`. Session cookie `oa_session` (httpOnly, SameSite=Lax, `Secure` by env).
42	- Times: ISO 8601 UTC strings. IDs: opaque strings with a type prefix (`u_`, `c_`, `m_`, `q_`, `t_`).
43	- **The frontend never formats or computes numbers.** Every number shown comes from a `*_display` field.
44	  High-precision values (`distance`, `price`, decimal strings) are only shown in the trace view.
45	- Errors: HTTP status + `{"error": {"code": "<snake_case>", "message": "<human text>"}}`.
46	  Common codes: `unauthorized` (401), `not_found` (404; also for other users' objects), `bad_request` (400),
47	  `rate_limited` (429), `llm_unavailable` (503).
48	
49	## Endpoints
50	
51	| Method | Path | Request | Response |
52	|---|---|---|---|
53	| GET | `/api/health` | – | `{"status":"ok","network_fingerprint":"sha256:…"}` |
54	| GET | `/api/config` | – | `{"dev_login":true,"google_client_id":null}` |
55	| POST | `/api/auth/dev` | `{"username","password"}` | `User` + sets cookie; 401 `invalid_credentials` |
56	| POST | `/api/auth/logout` | – | `{"ok":true}` |
57	| GET | `/api/me` | – | `User` or 401 |
58	| GET | `/api/conversations` | – | `{"conversations":[ConversationSummary]}` newest first |
59	| POST | `/api/conversations` | `{}` | `ConversationSummary` |
60	| GET | `/api/conversations/{id}` | – | `Conversation` (messages oldest first; card states are current server state) |
61	| POST | `/api/conversations/{id}/messages` | `{"text"}` | **SSE stream** (below) |
62	| POST | `/api/quotes/{id}/book` | `{"nonce"}` | `{"ticket": TicketCard, "message": Message}` or error (below) |
63	| GET | `/api/quotes/{id}/trace` | – | `Trace` |
64	| GET | `/api/tickets` | – | `{"tickets":[TicketCard]}` newest first |
65	| GET | `/api/debug/sse-ping` | – | SSE: `ping` with `{"seq":n}` immediately, then every 2 s, 5 events total |

67	Booking errors: `invalid_nonce` (409), `not_presented` (409), `expired` (409), `already_booked` (409),

70	## Objects
71	
72	```ts
73	type User = { id: string; display_name: string; auth_provider: "dev" | "google" }
74	type ConversationSummary = { id: string; title: string; created_at: string; updated_at: string; preview: string }
75	type Conversation = ConversationSummary & { messages: Message[] }
76	type Message = {
77	  id: string; role: "user" | "assistant" | "system"   // system = booking results etc.
78	  text: string                                        // markdown for assistant; plain for user
79	  cards: Card[]; created_at: string
80	}
81	type Leg = { from: string; to: string; distance_display: string; distance: string }
82	type CardState = { status: "quoted" | "presented" | "booked" | "expired" | "stale";
83	                   bookable: boolean; nonce: string | null; ticket_id: string | null }
84	
85	type Card = QuoteCard | BookingRequestCard | TicketCard | TicketListCard | NoServiceCard
86	          | AmbiguousCityCard | UnknownCityCard | NoticeCard
87	
88	type QuoteCard = { type: "quote"; id: string /* q_ */; origin: string; destination: string
89	  legs: Leg[]; transfers: string[]; distance_display: string; price_display: string
90	  distance: string; price: string; expires_at: string; state: CardState }
91	type BookingRequestCard = Omit<QuoteCard, "type"> & { type: "booking_request" }   // id is the quote id
92	type TicketCard = { type: "ticket"; id: string /* t_ */; quote_id: string; origin: string; destination: string
93	  legs: Leg[]; transfers: string[]; distance_display: string; price_display: string; booked_at: string }
94	type TicketListCard = { type: "ticket_list"; count: number; filter: Record<string, string>; tickets: TicketCard[] }
95	type NoServiceCard = { type: "no_service"; city: string
96	  nearest: { city: string; distance_display: string }[] }          // up to 3, nearest first
97	type AmbiguousCityCard = { type: "ambiguous_city"; query: string
98	  candidates: { city: string; is_hub: boolean; connected_hubs: string[] }[] }
99	type UnknownCityCard = { type: "unknown_city"; query: string; suggestions: string[] }
100	type NoticeCard = { type: "notice"; code: "same_city" | "unreachable" | "quote_expired" | "stale"; message: string }
101	
102	type Trace = { quote_id: string; formula: string; algorithm: string; network_fingerprint: string
103	  legs: (Leg & { from_coord: [number, number]; to_coord: [number, number]; source: string })[]
104	  distance: string; price: string; distance_display: string; price_display: string; note: string }
105	```
106	
107	Card buttons: a quote or booking-request card shows **Confirm booking** only when `state.bookable` is true; clicking
108	posts `{"nonce": state.nonce}` to `/api/quotes/{id}/book`. While a stream is running, buttons stay disabled until
109	`done`; after `done` (or on reload) the card state from the server wins.
110	
111	## SSE stream (`POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages`)
112	
113	`Content-Type: text/event-stream`. Each event: `event: <name>\ndata: <json>\n\n`.
114	
115	| event | data | notes |
116	|---|---|---|
117	| `user_message` | `Message` | the stored user message, first event |
118	| `status` | `{"text":"Looking up routes…"}` | progress, replaceable |
119	| `card` | `{"card": Card}` | push immediately; state.bookable is false until `done` |
120	| `delta` | `{"text":"…"}` | append; already validated text (one sentence or more) |
121	| `replace` | `{"text":"…"}` | replace the whole assistant text so far |
122	| `ping` | `{}` | heartbeat every 15 s; ignore |
123	| `done` | `{"message": Message}` | final assistant message incl. cards with current states |
124	| `error` | `{"code","message"}` | stream ends; the user message is kept |
125

264	    uri = path.resolve().as_uri() + "?mode=ro"
265	    try:

267	        try:
268	            locations = con.execute(

270	            ).fetchall()
271	            links = con.execute("SELECT hub_a, hub_b FROM hub_links ORDER BY rowid").fetchall()
272	        finally:

280	    """Load and validate the database. The hash and the rows are taken from the same file state:
281	    if the file changes while it is being read, the read is repeated."""
282	    path = Path(path)

292	class NetworkProvider:
293	    """Hands out the Network for the current content of the database file.
294	
295	    `current()` stats the file on every call; when mtime or size differ from the loaded state the
296	    content is hashed, and the Network is rebuilt only if the hash differs too. `strict=True`
297	    hashes unconditionally (for booking re-validation, where a missed change is not acceptable).
298	    A database that became invalid raises instead of serving the previous Network.
299	    """

301	    def __init__(self, path: str | Path):
302	        self.path = Path(path)
303	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
304	        self._net: Network | None = None
305	        self._stat: tuple[int, int] | None = None
306	
307	    def current(self, strict: bool = False) -> Network:
308	        with self._lock:
309	            stat = _stat(self.path)
310	            if self._net is not None:
311	                if stat == self._stat and not strict:
312	                    return self._net
313	                if _sha256(self.path) == self._net.fingerprint.sha256 and _stat(self.path) == stat:
314	                    self._stat = stat
315	                    return self._net
316	            self._net = None  # never serve a stale network after a failed reload
317	            net = load_network(self.path)
318	            self._net = net
319	            self._stat = (net.fingerprint.mtime_ns, net.fingerprint.size)
320	            return net

338	_EXTRA_FOLDS = str.maketrans(

343	def fold(name: str) -> str:
344	    """Matching key: case-insensitive, accent-insensitive, whitespace-normalized."""
345	    decomposed = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", name)
346	    stripped = "".join(ch for ch in decomposed if not unicodedata.combining(ch))
347	    return " ".join(stripped.casefold().translate(_EXTRA_FOLDS).split())

350	def build_fold_index(cities: Iterable[str]) -> Mapping[str, tuple[str, ...]]:
351	    """fold key -> every city with that key (a list on purpose: `San Jose` and `San José` share
352	    a key, and a one-to-one dict would silently drop one of them)."""
353	    index: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
354	    for name in cities:
355	        index.setdefault(fold(name), []).append(name)
356	    return {key: tuple(sorted(names)) for key, names in index.items()}

360	class Resolution:
361	    status: Literal["ok", "ambiguous", "unknown"]
362	    query: str
363	    city: str | None = None  # canonical name, status "ok" only
364	    similar_names: tuple[str, ...] = ()  # "ok": other cities equal after folding
365	    candidates: tuple[str, ...] = ()  # "ambiguous": all matches; "unknown": close names (<= 5)

368	def resolve(net: "Network", name: str) -> Resolution:
369	    """Exact name first (NFC, trimmed); then the folded key, which must hit exactly one city.
370	    Several hits are returned as `ambiguous`, never auto-picked."""
371	    if not isinstance(name, str):
372	        return Resolution("unknown", repr(name))
373	    exact = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", name).strip()
374	    key = fold(exact)
375	    same_key = net.fold_index.get(key, ())
376	    if exact in net.cities:
377	        return Resolution("ok", name, exact, tuple(n for n in same_key if n != exact))
378	    if len(same_key) == 1:
379	        return Resolution("ok", name, same_key[0])
380	    if same_key:
381	        return Resolution("ambiguous", name, candidates=same_key)
382	    if not key:
383	        return Resolution("unknown", name)
384	    close = difflib.get_close_matches(
385	        key, list(net.fold_index), n=MAX_SUGGESTIONS, cutoff=SUGGESTION_CUTOFF
386	    )
387	    names = [n for k in close for n in net.fold_index[k]]
388	    return Resolution("unknown", name, candidates=tuple(names[:MAX_SUGGESTIONS]))

457	    dx = ctx.subtract(bx, ax)

486	def price_path(net: "Network", cities: Sequence[str]) -> Priced:

489	    Refuses anything that is not bookable: unknown names, a leg that is not an operating flight,
490	    a transfer at a non-hub, or a city visited twice.
491	    """

495	    if len(set(cities)) != len(cities):

500	    for name in cities[1:-1]:

#!/bin/bash
# Runs every test suite that exists and prints one normalized line per failure: "FAIL <suite>: <test name>".
# Used by tool/test_diff.sh. Backend: pytest (FastAPI). Frontend: vitest (Next.js).
set -uo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
status=0
if [ -d backend ]; then
  (cd backend && HYPOTHESIS_PROFILE=ci uv run pytest -q --tb=short -rf) 2>&1 | tee /dev/stderr \
    | sed -nE 's/^FAILED ([^ ]+)( - .*)?$/FAIL backend: \1/p'
  [ "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" -ne 0 ] && status=1
fi
if [ -d frontend ] && [ -f frontend/package.json ]; then
  (cd frontend && npx vitest run) 2>&1 | tee /dev/stderr \
    | sed -nE 's/^ *(FAIL|×) +(.*[^ ])( [0-9]+ms)?$/FAIL frontend: \2/p'
  [ "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" -ne 0 ] && status=1
fi
exit $status
#!/bin/bash
# Only new failures count. Runs the test command, extracts failing test names with FAIL_PATTERN,
# and compares them with the baseline file (one name per line, committed).
#   tool/test_diff.sh                 compare
#   tool/test_diff.sh --update        rewrite the baseline (only on a reviewed main)
# Configure: TEST_CMD (default: tool/run_tests.sh, backend pytest + frontend vitest), FAIL_PATTERN (extended regex whose first capture group is the
# test name), BASELINE (default: tool/test_baseline.txt).
set -uo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
TEST_CMD=${TEST_CMD:-tool/run_tests.sh 2>/dev/null}
FAIL_PATTERN=${FAIL_PATTERN:-'^FAIL (.*)$'}
BASELINE=${BASELINE:-tool/test_baseline.txt}
LOG=$(mktemp); NOW=$(mktemp)
bash -c "$TEST_CMD" > "$LOG" 2>&1
sed -nE "s/${FAIL_PATTERN}/\1/p" "$LOG" | sort -u > "$NOW"
if [ "${1:-}" = "--update" ]; then cp "$NOW" "$BASELINE"; echo "baseline: $(wc -l < "$BASELINE") failure(s)"; exit 0; fi
touch "$BASELINE"
NEW=$(comm -13 "$BASELINE" "$NOW"); FIXED=$(comm -23 "$BASELINE" "$NOW")
[ -n "$FIXED" ] && { echo "now passing (update the baseline):"; echo "$FIXED" | sed 's/^/  /'; }
if [ -n "$NEW" ]; then
  echo "NEW failures:"; echo "$NEW" | sed 's/^/  /'
  echo "Wall-clock benchmarks: rerun alone before counting them (explain the number)."
  exit 1
fi
echo "no new failures ($(wc -l < "$NOW") known)"
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""A tiny model-based testing harness (language-neutral pattern; port it to your test framework).

You provide: a generator of random events, a reference model, the system under test (or an adapter over the
real code), and invariants. The harness runs seeded sequences, checks every invariant after every event,
and on failure shrinks the sequence and prints it as a regression case.
"""
import random


def run(seq, make_model, make_system, invariants):
    model, system = make_model(), make_system()
    for i, ev in enumerate(seq):
        model.apply(ev)
        system.apply(ev)
        for inv in invariants:
            ok, why = inv(model, system)
            if not ok:
                return i, inv.__name__, why
    return None


def shrink(seq, fails):
    """Remove chunks, then single events, while the sequence still fails."""
    n = 2
    while len(seq) >= 2:
        chunk = max(1, len(seq) // n)
        for start in range(0, len(seq), chunk):
            cand = seq[:start] + seq[start + chunk:]
            if fails(cand):
                seq, n = cand, max(n - 1, 2)
                break
        else:
            if chunk == 1:
                break
            n = min(n * 2, len(seq))
    return seq


def check(gen_event, make_model, make_system, invariants, seeds=range(200), length=200):
    for seed in seeds:
        rng = random.Random(seed)
        seq = [gen_event(rng) for _ in range(length)]
        res = run(seq, make_model, make_system, invariants)
        if res:
            small = shrink(seq, lambda s: run(s, make_model, make_system, invariants) is not None)
            i, name, why = run(small, make_model, make_system, invariants)
            raise AssertionError(f'seed {seed}: {name} broke at event {i}: {why}\n'
                                 f'keep as a named case:\n  {small}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    # Example: a counter that must never exceed a cap of 3 offers per install.
    class Model:
        def __init__(self): self.shows = 0
        def apply(self, ev):
            if ev == 'aha' and self.shows < 3: self.shows += 1
    class Buggy(Model):
        def apply(self, ev):
            if ev == 'aha': self.shows += 1           # forgets the cap
            if ev == 'reinstall': self.shows = 0
    def cap(model, system): return system.shows <= 3, f'shows={system.shows}'
    gen = lambda rng: rng.choice(['aha', 'clock', 'reinstall'])
    check(gen, Model, Model, [cap])
    print('model vs model: ok')
    try:
        check(gen, Model, Buggy, [cap])
    except AssertionError as e:
        print('buggy system caught:', str(e).splitlines()[0])
        print(str(e).splitlines()[-1])

You provide: a generator of random events, a reference model, the system under test (or an adapter over the
real code), and invariants. The harness runs seeded sequences, checks every invariant after every event,
and on failure shrinks the sequence and prints it as a regression case.
"""
import random


def run(seq, make_model, make_system, invariants):
    model, system = make_model(), make_system()
    for i, ev in enumerate(seq):
        model.apply(ev)
        system.apply(ev)
        for inv in invariants:
            ok, why = inv(model, system)
            if not ok:
                return i, inv.__name__, why
    return None


def shrink(seq, fails):
    """Remove chunks, then single events, while the sequence still fails."""
    n = 2
    while len(seq) >= 2:
        chunk = max(1, len(seq) // n)
        for start in range(0, len(seq), chunk):
            cand = seq[:start] + seq[start + chunk:]
            if fails(cand):
                seq, n = cand, max(n - 1, 2)
                break
        else:
            if chunk == 1:
                break
            n = min(n * 2, len(seq))
    return seq


def check(gen_event, make_model, make_system, invariants, seeds=range(200), length=200):
    for seed in seeds:
        rng = random.Random(seed)
        seq = [gen_event(rng) for _ in range(length)]
        res = run(seq, make_model, make_system, invariants)
        if res:
            small = shrink(seq, lambda s: run(s, make_model, make_system, invariants) is not None)
            i, name, why = run(small, make_model, make_system, invariants)
            raise AssertionError(f'seed {seed}: {name} broke at event {i}: {why}\n'
                                 f'keep as a named case:\n  {small}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    # Example: a counter that must never exceed a cap of 3 offers per install.
    class Model:
        def __init__(self): self.shows = 0
        def apply(self, ev):
            if ev == 'aha' and self.shows < 3: self.shows += 1
    class Buggy(Model):
        def apply(self, ev):
            if ev == 'aha': self.shows += 1           # forgets the cap
            if ev == 'reinstall': self.shows = 0
    def cap(model, system): return system.shows <= 3, f'shows={system.shows}'
    gen = lambda rng: rng.choice(['aha', 'clock', 'reinstall'])
    check(gen, Model, Model, [cap])
    print('model vs model: ok')
    try:
        check(gen, Model, Buggy, [cap])
    except AssertionError as e:
        print('buggy system caught:', str(e).splitlines()[0])
        print(str(e).splitlines()[-1])

"""Independent reference implementation for cross-checking app.core.

Deliberately shares NO code with app/: it reads the database itself, builds its own graph, does
its own Decimal arithmetic and its own search (plain Bellman-Ford relaxation, plus an exhaustive
path enumeration for small graphs). Only the specification is shared:

- flights: hub<->hub rows of hub_links, non-hub<->each hub in its connected_hubs, both directions;
- a route may change planes only at hubs;
- leg distance = Euclidean distance; ticket distance = sum of legs in travel order;
  price = distance * 0.13; arithmetic in Decimal prec 50 ROUND_HALF_EVEN; results quantized to
  30 decimal places;
- cheapest route = smallest quantized price; ties by fewer legs, then by the city-name sequence.
"""
import sqlite3
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_EVEN, Context, Decimal

Q30 = Decimal("0.000000000000000000000000000001")
RATE = Decimal("0.13")
# Partial paths more than this above the best known partial path can never end up tied after
# rounding to 30 dp; anything closer is kept so that ties are decided by the full rule.
KEEP = Decimal("1e-20")


def ctx():
    return Context(prec=50, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)


class RefGraph:
    def __init__(self, location_rows, link_rows):
        self.xy = {}
        self.hubs = set()
        self.spokes = {}
        self.hub_adj = {}
        for name, coord, is_hub, connected in location_rows:
            x, y = coord.split(",")
            self.xy[name] = (Decimal(x), Decimal(y))
            if is_hub:
                self.hubs.add(name)
                self.hub_adj[name] = set()
            else:
                self.spokes[name] = [h for h in connected.split(";") if h]
        for a, b in link_rows:
            self.hub_adj[a].add(b)
            self.hub_adj[b].add(a)
        self.spoke_cities = {h: [] for h in self.hubs}
        for city, hubs in self.spokes.items():
            for h in hubs:
                self.spoke_cities[h].append(city)

    @classmethod
    def from_db(cls, path):
        con = sqlite3.connect(path)
        try:
            return cls(
                con.execute("select city_name, coordinate, is_hub, connected_hubs from locations").fetchall(),
                con.execute("select hub_a, hub_b from hub_links").fetchall(),
            )
        finally:
            con.close()

    def served(self, city):
        if city in self.hubs:
            return bool(self.hub_adj[city] or self.spoke_cities[city])
        return bool(self.spokes[city])

    def dist(self, a, b, c):
        (ax, ay), (bx, by) = self.xy[a], self.xy[b]
        dx, dy = c.subtract(ax, bx), c.subtract(ay, by)
        return c.sqrt(c.add(c.multiply(dx, dx), c.multiply(dy, dy)))

    def flights_from(self, city):
        if city in self.hubs:
            return sorted(self.hub_adj[city]) + sorted(self.spoke_cities[city])
        return list(self.spokes[city])

    def total(self, path, c):
        s = None
        for a, b in zip(path, path[1:]):
            d = self.dist(a, b, c)
            s = d if s is None else c.add(s, d)
        return s

    def score(self, path, total, c):
        price = c.multiply(total, RATE).quantize(Q30, context=c)
        return (price, len(path) - 1, tuple(path))

    def answer(self, scored, total, c):
        price, _, path = scored
        return {"cities": path, "price": format(price, "f"),
                "distance": format(total.quantize(Q30, context=c), "f")}

    # --- exhaustive enumeration (small graphs only) -------------------------------------------
    def brute_force(self, origin, dest):
        c = ctx()
        best = None
        stack = [(origin,)]
        while stack:
            path = stack.pop()
            last = path[-1]
            if last == dest:
                total = self.total(path, c)
                cand = (self.score(path, total, c), total)
                if best is None or cand[0] < best[0]:
                    best = cand
                continue
            if len(path) > 1 and last not in self.hubs:
                continue  # may not change planes here
            for nxt in self.flights_from(last):
                if nxt not in path:
                    stack.append(path + (nxt,))
        return None if best is None else self.answer(best[0], best[1], c)

    # --- Bellman-Ford over the hubs, one run per origin ---------------------------------------
    def hub_labels(self, origin):
        """hub -> {path from origin ending at that hub: unrounded length}, near-optimal only."""
        c = ctx()
        labels = {h: {} for h in self.hubs}
        if origin in self.hubs:
            labels[origin][(origin,)] = Decimal(0)
        else:
            for h in self.spokes[origin]:
                labels[h][(origin, h)] = self.dist(origin, h, c)
        changed = True
        rounds = 0
        while changed:
            changed = False
            rounds += 1
            assert rounds <= len(self.hubs) + 2, "relaxation did not converge"
            for u in self.hubs:
                for path, length in list(labels[u].items()):
                    for v in self.hub_adj[u]:
                        if v in path:
                            continue
                        new_path = path + (v,)
                        if new_path in labels[v]:
                            continue
                        step = self.dist(u, v, c)
                        new_len = step if len(path) == 1 else c.add(length, step)
                        best_v = min(labels[v].values(), default=None)
                        if best_v is not None and new_len > best_v + KEEP:
                            continue
                        labels[v][new_path] = new_len
                        low = min(labels[v].values())
                        for p in [p for p, l in labels[v].items() if l > low + KEEP]:
                            del labels[v][p]
                        changed = True
        return labels

    def bellman_ford_from(self, origin):
        """dest -> answer dict, for every city reachable from origin (origin excluded)."""
        c = ctx()
        labels = self.hub_labels(origin)
        out = {}
        for dest in self.xy:
            if dest == origin:
                continue
            finals = []
            if dest in self.hubs:
                finals = [(p, l) for p, l in labels[dest].items()]
            else:
                for h in self.spokes[dest]:
                    last = self.dist(h, dest, c)
                    for p, l in labels[h].items():
                        finals.append((p + (dest,), last if len(p) == 1 else c.add(l, last)))
            best = None
            for path, total in finals:
                cand = (self.score(path, total, c), total)
                if best is None or cand[0] < best[0]:
                    best = cand
            if best is not None:
                out[dest] = self.answer(best[0], best[1], c)
        return out

    def nearest_served(self, city, k, exclude=()):
        c = Context(prec=60)
        ranked = sorted(
            (self.dist(city, other, c), other)
            for other in self.xy
            if other != city and other not in exclude and self.served(other)
        )
        return [name for _, name in ranked[:k]]

## 0. GitHub 调研：「只在 hub 中转」有没有比 networkx 更合适的成熟方案

2026-11-23，`gh search repos` / `gh search code` + 一次网页搜索。结论：**没有，沿用 networkx**。

| 搜索词 | 结果 | 判断 |
|---|---|---|
| `hub-constrained shortest path`、`transfer only at hubs routing`、`hub and spoke shortest path`、`flight routing hub dijkstra`；代码搜索 `"transfer only at hubs"` | 0 个仓库 / 0 处代码（另有一个 0 星的课程作业 `vjain0812/flight_route_shortest_path_finder`） | 没有针对这条规则的专用库 |
| `hub labeling` | `savrus/hl`（C++，★60）、`lviennot/hub-labeling`（C++，★9）、`albvera/HHL_CSP`（★8） | 名字相近、含义不同：这是 2-hop labeling，给百万节点路网做查询加速的索引，和「只能在 hub 换乘」的约束无关；C++，无 Python 包 |
| `contraction hierarchies` | `UDST/pandana`（★434）、`GVeitBatz/KaTCH`、`LdDl/ch` | 同样是大图加速技术；我们的 hub 图只有 40 点 151 边 |
| `RAPTOR transit routing python`、`lviennot/hl-csa-raptor` | 基于时刻表的公交换乘算法 | 需要时刻表，locations.db 里没有 |
| `rustworkx`（`Qiskit/rustworkx`，★1786） | 通用图库，Rust 实现 | 能做同样的事，但也没有「限制中间点」的现成选项；多一个二进制依赖，40 个点上没有速度需求。不采用 |
| networkx 讨论区 #4832（constrained shortest path） | 维护者建议把约束建进图的结构（状态图） | 正是本实现的做法：非 hub 城市根本不进搜索图，只作端点 |

做法：约束通过**建图**表达（搜索图只含 hub 和 hub_links），不需要专用算法；networkx 3.7（★17k，纯 Python）

## 1. 做了什么（按计划条目）

- **backend/ uv 项目**：`pyproject.toml` + `uv.lock`；运行依赖 fastapi、uvicorn、networkx；dev 依赖 pytest、
  hypothesis、httpx。包目录 `backend/app/`（`app/core/*`、`app/main.py`）。
- **network**（`app/core/network.py`）：`load_network(path)` 以 `file:…?mode=ro` 打开；`build_network(rows, links, fp)`
  做全部校验并构造不可变 `Network`（真实库和测试生成的图走同一段校验代码）。校验：城市名（非空、无首尾空白、
  不含 `;`、不重复）、坐标（`x,y`，整数或小数，不允许空格）、`is_hub` 只能是整数 0/1、`connected_hubs`（每项存在、
  是 hub、不重复、无空项；hub 必须为空）、`hub_links`（两端存在、是 hub、非自环）。任何一条不满足抛
  `NetworkDataError`，不修正。`Fingerprint(sha256, size, mtime_ns)`，`.id = "sha256:…"`。读取时前后各取一次
  stat + sha256，不一致则重读（最多 3 次），保证哈希和数据来自同一文件状态。
  `NetworkProvider.current()`：每次 stat，mtime/size 变了再算 sha256，内容真的变了才重载；`current(strict=True)`
  无条件重新哈希；重载失败时抛错且不再返回旧 Network。
- **pricing**（`app/core/pricing.py`）：`price_path(net, cities) -> Priced`，每次调用新建
  `Context(prec=50, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)`，全部运算用 `ctx.xxx(...)` 形式；按航段顺序求未舍入距离之和，
  × `Decimal("0.13")`；每段距离、总距离、价格各量化一次为 30 位小数字符串。它同时拒绝不可订的序列（未知城市、
  不存在的航段、在非 hub 中转、重复城市）→ `InvalidPathError`。`fmt_km`（1 位，HALF_UP，`"5.0 km"`）、

"""Independent reference implementation for cross-checking app.core.

Deliberately shares NO code with app/: it reads the database itself, builds its own graph, does
its own Decimal arithmetic and its own search (plain Bellman-Ford relaxation, plus an exhaustive
path enumeration for small graphs). Only the specification is shared:

- flights: hub<->hub rows of hub_links, non-hub<->each hub in its connected_hubs, both directions;
- a route may change planes only at hubs;
- leg distance = Euclidean distance; ticket distance = sum of legs in travel order;
  price = distance * 0.13; arithmetic in Decimal prec 50 ROUND_HALF_EVEN; results quantized to
  30 decimal places;
- cheapest route = smallest quantized price; ties by fewer legs, then by the city-name sequence.
"""
import sqlite3
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_EVEN, Context, Decimal

Q30 = Decimal("0.000000000000000000000000000001")
RATE = Decimal("0.13")
# Partial paths more than this above the best known partial path can never end up tied after
# rounding to 30 dp; anything closer is kept so that ties are decided by the full rule.
KEEP = Decimal("1e-20")


def ctx():
    return Context(prec=50, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)


class RefGraph:
    def __init__(self, location_rows, link_rows):
        self.xy = {}
        self.hubs = set()
        self.spokes = {}
        self.hub_adj = {}
        for name, coord, is_hub, connected in location_rows:
            x, y = coord.split(",")
            self.xy[name] = (Decimal(x), Decimal(y))
            if is_hub:
                self.hubs.add(name)
                self.hub_adj[name] = set()
            else:
                self.spokes[name] = [h for h in connected.split(";") if h]
        for a, b in link_rows:
            self.hub_adj[a].add(b)
            self.hub_adj[b].add(a)
        self.spoke_cities = {h: [] for h in self.hubs}
        for city, hubs in self.spokes.items():
            for h in hubs:
                self.spoke_cities[h].append(city)

    @classmethod
    def from_db(cls, path):
        con = sqlite3.connect(path)
        try:
            return cls(
                con.execute("select city_name, coordinate, is_hub, connected_hubs from locations").fetchall(),
                con.execute("select hub_a, hub_b from hub_links").fetchall(),
            )
        finally:
            con.close()

    def served(self, city):
        if city in self.hubs:
            return bool(self.hub_adj[city] or self.spoke_cities[city])
        return bool(self.spokes[city])

    def dist(self, a, b, c):
        (ax, ay), (bx, by) = self.xy[a], self.xy[b]
        dx, dy = c.subtract(ax, bx), c.subtract(ay, by)
        return c.sqrt(c.add(c.multiply(dx, dx), c.multiply(dy, dy)))

    def flights_from(self, city):
        if city in self.hubs:
            return sorted(self.hub_adj[city]) + sorted(self.spoke_cities[city])
        return list(self.spokes[city])

    def total(self, path, c):
        s = None
        for a, b in zip(path, path[1:]):
            d = self.dist(a, b, c)
            s = d if s is None else c.add(s, d)
        return s

    def score(self, path, total, c):
        price = c.multiply(total, RATE).quantize(Q30, context=c)
        return (price, len(path) - 1, tuple(path))

    def answer(self, scored, total, c):
        price, _, path = scored
        return {"cities": path, "price": format(price, "f"),
                "distance": format(total.quantize(Q30, context=c), "f")}

    # --- exhaustive enumeration (small graphs only) -------------------------------------------
    def brute_force(self, origin, dest):
        c = ctx()
        best = None
        stack = [(origin,)]
        while stack:
            path = stack.pop()
            last = path[-1]
            if last == dest:
                total = self.total(path, c)
                cand = (self.score(path, total, c), total)
                if best is None or cand[0] < best[0]:
                    best = cand
                continue
            if len(path) > 1 and last not in self.hubs:
                continue  # may not change planes here
            for nxt in self.flights_from(last):
                if nxt not in path:
                    stack.append(path + (nxt,))
        return None if best is None else self.answer(best[0], best[1], c)

    # --- Bellman-Ford over the hubs, one run per origin ---------------------------------------
    def hub_labels(self, origin):
        """hub -> {path from origin ending at that hub: unrounded length}, near-optimal only."""
        c = ctx()
        labels = {h: {} for h in self.hubs}
        if origin in self.hubs:
            labels[origin][(origin,)] = Decimal(0)
        else:
            for h in self.spokes[origin]:
                labels[h][(origin, h)] = self.dist(origin, h, c)
        changed = True
        rounds = 0
        while changed:
            changed = False
            rounds += 1
            assert rounds <= len(self.hubs) + 2, "relaxation did not converge"
            for u in self.hubs:
                for path, length in list(labels[u].items()):
                    for v in self.hub_adj[u]:
                        if v in path:
                            continue
                        new_path = path + (v,)
                        if new_path in labels[v]:
                            continue
                        step = self.dist(u, v, c)
                        new_len = step if len(path) == 1 else c.add(length, step)
                        best_v = min(labels[v].values(), default=None)
                        if best_v is not None and new_len > best_v + KEEP:
                            continue
                        labels[v][new_path] = new_len
                        low = min(labels[v].values())
                        for p in [p for p, l in labels[v].items() if l > low + KEEP]:
                            del labels[v][p]
                        changed = True
        return labels

    def bellman_ford_from(self, origin):
        """dest -> answer dict, for every city reachable from origin (origin excluded)."""
        c = ctx()
        labels = self.hub_labels(origin)
        out = {}
        for dest in self.xy:
            if dest == origin:
                continue
            finals = []
            if dest in self.hubs:
                finals = [(p, l) for p, l in labels[dest].items()]
            else:
                for h in self.spokes[dest]:
                    last = self.dist(h, dest, c)
                    for p, l in labels[h].items():
                        finals.append((p + (dest,), last if len(p) == 1 else c.add(l, last)))
            best = None
            for path, total in finals:
                cand = (self.score(path, total, c), total)
                if best is None or cand[0] < best[0]:
                    best = cand
            if best is not None:
                out[dest] = self.answer(best[0], best[1], c)
        return out

    def nearest_served(self, city, k, exclude=()):
        c = Context(prec=60)
        ranked = sorted(
            (self.dist(city, other, c), other)
            for other in self.xy
            if other != city and other not in exclude and self.served(other)
        )
        return [name for _, name in ranked[:k]]

"""One lock per conversation, shared by chat turns and the booking endpoint (design §4.6, B7).

In-process only: the API runs as a single uvicorn worker. The database does not rely on this lock
for B5/B7 (those hold through `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` and `tickets.quote_id UNIQUE`); the lock keeps a
booking click and a running chat turn of the same conversation from interleaving.

The lock is NOT reentrant. `Airline.book` takes it itself; everything else in `Airline` expects
the caller (the chat turn) to hold it.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import threading
import time
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager, contextmanager
from typing import AsyncIterator, Iterator


class ConversationBusy(Exception):
    """The conversation lock was not obtained within the timeout."""


class ConversationLocks:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._mutex = threading.Lock()
        self._entries: dict[str, list] = {}  # conversation id -> [lock, holders + waiters]

    def _checkout(self, conversation_id: str) -> threading.Lock:
        with self._mutex:
            entry = self._entries.setdefault(conversation_id, [threading.Lock(), 0])
            entry[1] += 1
            return entry[0]

        with self._mutex:

"""One lock per conversation, shared by chat turns and the booking endpoint (design §4.6, B7).

In-process only: the API runs as a single uvicorn worker. The database does not rely on this lock
for B5/B7 (those hold through `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` and `tickets.quote_id UNIQUE`); the lock keeps a
booking click and a running chat turn of the same conversation from interleaving.

The lock is NOT reentrant. `Airline.book` takes it itself; everything else in `Airline` expects
the caller (the chat turn) to hold it.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import threading
import time
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager, contextmanager
from typing import AsyncIterator, Iterator


class ConversationBusy(Exception):
    """The conversation lock was not obtained within the timeout."""


class ConversationLocks:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._mutex = threading.Lock()
        self._entries: dict[str, list] = {}  # conversation id -> [lock, holders + waiters]

    def _checkout(self, conversation_id: str) -> threading.Lock:
        with self._mutex:
            entry = self._entries.setdefault(conversation_id, [threading.Lock(), 0])
            entry[1] += 1
            return entry[0]

    def _checkin(self, conversation_id: str) -> None:
        with self._mutex:
            entry = self._entries[conversation_id]
            entry[1] -= 1
            if entry[1] == 0:
                del self._entries[conversation_id]

    @contextmanager
    def hold(self, conversation_id: str, timeout: float | None = None) -> Iterator[None]:
        """Blocking form, for sync code (threadpool endpoints). Never call it on the event loop:
        use `hold_async` there."""
        lock = self._checkout(conversation_id)
        try:
            if not lock.acquire(timeout=-1 if timeout is None else timeout):
                raise ConversationBusy(conversation_id)
            try:
                yield
            finally:
                lock.release()
        finally:
            self._checkin(conversation_id)

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def hold_async(self, conversation_id: str, timeout: float | None = None,
                         poll: float = 0.01) -> AsyncIterator[None]:
        """Async form of the same lock: waits without blocking the event loop, safe to cancel
        while waiting, and may be held across awaits (a whole streamed turn)."""
        lock = self._checkout(conversation_id)
        try:
            deadline = None if timeout is None else time.monotonic() + timeout
            while not lock.acquire(blocking=False):
                if deadline is not None and time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                    raise ConversationBusy(conversation_id)
                await asyncio.sleep(poll)
            try:
                yield
            finally:
                lock.release()
        finally:
            self._checkin(conversation_id)

    def locked(self, conversation_id: str) -> bool:
        with self._mutex:
            entry = self._entries.get(conversation_id)
            return entry is not None and entry[0].locked()

import sqlite3
import threading
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import pytest

from app.store import SCHEMA_VERSION, Store, iso, parse_iso, records

from .airline_helpers import FakeClock


@pytest.fixture
def store(tmp_path):
    return Store(tmp_path / "data" / "app.db", clock=FakeClock())


def raw(store, query, args=()):
    con = sqlite3.connect(store.path)
    try:
        return con.execute(query, args).fetchall()
    finally:
        con.close()


def test_schema_has_the_design_tables_and_is_versioned(store):
    tables = {r[0] for r in raw(store, "select name from sqlite_master where type = 'table'")}
    assert {"users", "conversations", "messages", "llm_calls", "tool_calls", "quotes", "quote_cards",
            "tickets"} <= tables
    assert raw(store, "pragma user_version") == [(SCHEMA_VERSION,)]
    assert raw(store, "pragma journal_mode") == [("wal",)]


def test_opening_again_keeps_the_data_and_does_not_migrate_twice(store):
    user = store.upsert_user("dev", "demo", "demo")
    again = Store(store.path)
    assert again.get_user(user["id"])["display_name"] == "demo"
    assert raw(store, "pragma user_version") == [(SCHEMA_VERSION,)]


def test_a_newer_schema_is_refused(store):
    con = sqlite3.connect(store.path)
    con.execute(f"pragma user_version = {SCHEMA_VERSION + 1}")
    con.close()
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="schema"):
        Store(store.path)


def test_times_are_utc_seconds_and_need_a_timezone():
    moment = datetime(2026, 11, 23, 16, 0, 0, 987654, tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=8)))
    assert iso(moment) == "2026-11-23T08:00:00Z"
    assert parse_iso("2026-11-23T08:00:00Z") == datetime(2026, 11, 23, 8, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        iso(datetime(2026, 11, 23))


def test_users_are_unique_per_provider_and_subject(store):
    a = store.upsert_user("dev", "demo", "demo", email="demo@example-mail.test")
    b = store.upsert_user("dev", "demo", "Demo User")
    c = store.upsert_user("google", "demo", "demo")
    assert a["id"] == b["id"] != c["id"]
    assert a["id"].startswith("u_") and b["display_name"] == "Demo User"
    assert store.get_user("u_missing") is None
    assert raw(store, "select count(*) from users") == [(2,)]


def test_conversations_newest_first_with_preview_and_ownership(store):
    alice = store.upsert_user("dev", "alice", "Alice")["id"]
    bob = store.upsert_user("dev", "bob", "Bob")["id"]
    first = store.create_conversation(alice, "first")
    store.clock.advance(seconds=5)
    second = store.create_conversation(alice)
    assert set(first) == {"id", "title", "created_at", "updated_at", "preview"}
    assert [c["id"] for c in store.list_conversations(alice)] == [second["id"], first["id"]]

    store.clock.advance(seconds=5)
    store.add_message(first["id"], "user", "x" * 500)
    listed = store.list_conversations(alice)
    assert [c["id"] for c in listed] == [first["id"], second["id"]]  # updated_at moved
    assert listed[0]["preview"] == "x" * 120 and listed[0]["updated_at"] == "2026-11-23T08:00:10Z"
    assert listed[1]["preview"] == ""

    assert store.get_conversation(alice, first["id"])["title"] == "first"
    assert store.get_conversation(bob, first["id"]) is None  # not the owner: same as missing
    assert store.list_conversations(bob) == []
    assert store.set_conversation_title(bob, first["id"], "hijack") is False
    assert store.set_conversation_title(alice, first["id"], "Guangzhou to Lima") is True
    assert store.get_conversation(alice, first["id"])["title"] == "Guangzhou to Lima"


def test_messages_keep_insertion_order_even_within_one_second(store):
    user = store.upsert_user("dev", "demo", "demo")["id"]
    conv = store.create_conversation(user)["id"]
    sent = [store.add_message(conv, role, f"m{i}", [{"type": "notice", "code": "same_city", "message": "é"}])
            for i, role in enumerate(["user", "assistant", "system", "user"])]
    got = store.list_messages(conv)
    assert [m["id"] for m in got] == [m["id"] for m in sent]
    assert got[1]["cards"] == [{"type": "notice", "code": "same_city", "message": "é"}]
    assert got[0]["guard_problems"] is None and all(m["id"].startswith("m_") for m in got)
    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):
        store.add_message(conv, "robot", "bad role")
    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):
        store.add_message("c_missing", "user", "no such conversation")


def test_call_logs_round_trip_json(store):
    user = store.upsert_user("dev", "demo", "demo")["id"]
    conv = store.create_conversation(user)["id"]
    message = store.add_message(conv, "user", "hi", guard_problems=None)
    store.add_llm_call(conv, {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}]}, {"text": "héllo"},
                       latency_ms=120, tokens=42, model="example-model")
    store.add_tool_call(message["id"], "find_city", {"name": "Lima"}, {"code": "ok"}, latency_ms=3)
    store.add_tool_call(message["id"], "quote_route", {"origin": 1}, error="bad arguments")
    llm = store.list_llm_calls(conv)
    assert llm[0]["response"] == {"text": "héllo"} and llm[0]["tokens"] == 42
    tools = store.list_tool_calls(message["id"])
    assert [t["name"] for t in tools] == ["find_city", "quote_route"]
    assert tools[0]["result"] == {"code": "ok"} and tools[1]["result"] is None
    assert tools[1]["error"] == "bad arguments"


def test_write_rolls_back_on_error_and_commits_otherwise(store):
    with pytest.raises(ZeroDivisionError):
        with store.write() as con:
            records.upsert_user(con, store.now(), "dev", "ghost", "ghost")
            1 / 0
    assert raw(store, "select count(*) from users") == [(0,)]
    with store.write() as con:
        records.upsert_user(con, store.now(), "dev", "real", "real")
    assert raw(store, "select count(*) from users") == [(1,)]


def test_write_is_begin_immediate_so_writers_queue(store):
    """A second writer cannot even start while the first transaction is open."""
    order = []
    inside = threading.Event()
    release = threading.Event()

    def first():
        with store.write() as con:
            records.upsert_user(con, store.now(), "dev", "one", "one")
            inside.set()
            release.wait(5)
            order.append("first commits")

    def second():
        inside.wait(5)
        with store.write() as con:
            order.append("second starts")
            assert con.execute("select count(*) from users").fetchone()[0] == 1

    threads = [threading.Thread(target=first), threading.Thread(target=second)]
    for t in threads:
        t.start()
    inside.wait(5)
    threads[1].join(0.2)  # the second writer is blocked on BEGIN IMMEDIATE
    assert order == []
    release.set()
    for t in threads:
        t.join(5)
    assert order == ["first commits", "second starts"]


def _quote(store, con, user, conv):
    return records.insert_quote(
        con, now=store.now(), expires_at=store.now(), conversation_id=conv, user_id=user,
        origin="A", destination="B",
        legs=[{"from": "A", "to": "B", "distance": "1.0", "from_coord": ["0", "0"],
               "to_coord": ["1", "0"], "source": "hub_links(A, B)"}],
        distance="1.0", price="0.13", network_fingerprint="sha256:test",
    )


def test_database_guards_one_ticket_per_presented_quote_and_terminal_states(store):
    """The schema itself refuses the states B2, B5, B7 and Q3 forbid, whatever the code does."""
    user = store.upsert_user("dev", "demo", "demo")["id"]
    conv = store.create_conversation(user)["id"]
    message = store.add_message(conv, "assistant", "card")["id"]
    with store.write() as con:
        quote = _quote(store, con, user, conv)
        assert quote["status"] == "quoted" and quote["legs"][0]["to_coord"] == ["1", "0"]
        with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError, match="presented"):  # B2: not presented yet
            records.insert_ticket(con, now=store.now(), quote=quote, network_fingerprint="x",
                                  confirmed_message_id=message)
        records.set_quote_status(con, quote, "presented", store.now())
        ticket = records.insert_ticket(con, now=store.now(), quote=quote, network_fingerprint="x",
                                       confirmed_message_id=message)
        assert ticket["id"].startswith("t_") and ticket["legs_snapshot"] == quote["legs"]
        with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError, match="UNIQUE"):  # B5

    assert [c["id"] for c in store.list_conversations(alice)] == [second["id"], first["id"]]

    assert listed[0]["preview"] == "x" * 120 and listed[0]["updated_at"] == "2026-11-23T08:00:10Z"
    assert listed[1]["preview"] == ""

    assert store.get_conversation(alice, first["id"])["title"] == "first"

    """A second writer cannot even start while the first transaction is open."""
    order = []
    inside = threading.Event()
    release = threading.Event()

    def first():
        with store.write() as con:
            records.upsert_user(con, store.now(), "dev", "one", "one")
            inside.set()
            release.wait(5)
            order.append("first commits")

    def second():
        inside.wait(5)
        with store.write() as con:
            order.append("second starts")

def test_every_card_type_of_the_contract_has_a_fixture_example():

            "unknown_city", "notice", "message", "trace", "booking_ok", "error"} <= set(SCHEMAS)

    card = json.loads((FIXTURES / "tickets.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["tickets"][0]
    assert_card(card, SCHEMAS)
    for broken in (
        {k: v for k, v in card.items() if k != "booked_at"},
        {**card, "extra": 1},
        {**card, "price_display": 1160.71},
        {**card, "legs": [{**card["legs"][0], "distance": 1362.1}]},

def test_the_contract_example_route_on_the_real_db(real):

def test_quote_route_checks_the_conversation_owner(world):
    for origin, destination in (("A", "D"), ("A", "A")):  # with and without a route

def test_tools_raise_when_locations_db_is_broken(world):

# --- trace -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_trace_shows_sources_coordinates_and_the_core_formula(world):
    quote_id = world.quote("A", "C").data["quote_id"]
    trace = world.airline.trace(world.alice, quote_id)

    assert [(l["from"], l["to"], l["from_coord"], l["to_coord"], l["source"]) for l in trace["legs"]] == [

        ("H1", "H3", [0, 0], [30, 40], "hub_links(H1, H3)"),
        ("H3", "C", [30, 40], [60, 40], "locations.connected_hubs(C)"),
    ]
    assert trace["distance"] == "90." + Z and trace["price_display"] == "$11.70"


def test_trace_is_only_for_the_owner(world):
    quote_id = world.quote().data["quote_id"]
    with pytest.raises(NotFound):
        world.airline.trace(world.bob, quote_id)
    with pytest.raises(NotFound):
        world.airline.trace(world.alice, "q_missing")
    assert world.airline.get_quote(world.bob, quote_id) is None
    assert world.airline.get_quote(world.alice, quote_id)["state"]["status"] == "quoted"


def test_fractional_coordinates_are_numbers_in_the_trace(world):
    world.edit_db("update locations set coordinate = '0.5,-10' where city_name = 'A'")
    trace = world.airline.trace(world.alice, world.quote("A", "H1").data["quote_id"])

# --- request_booking ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_request_booking_returns_a_confirm_card_without_a_nonce(world):
    quote_id, _ = world.presented()
    r = world.airline.request_booking(world.alice, world.conv, quote_id)
    assert r.ok and r.data["quote_id"] == quote_id and r.data["status"] == "presented"
    card = r.cards[0]
    assert_card(card, SCHEMAS)
    assert card["type"] == "booking_request" and card["id"] == quote_id
    assert card["state"] == {"status": "presented", "bookable": False, "nonce": None, "ticket_id": None}
    quote_card = world.airline.get_quote(world.alice, quote_id)
    assert {k: v for k, v in card.items() if k not in ("type", "state")} == \
           {k: v for k, v in quote_card.items() if k not in ("type", "state")}
    no_nonce_anywhere(r)
    assert world.ticket_count() == 0 and world.status(quote_id) == "presented"


def test_request_booking_in_the_same_turn_as_the_quote(world):
    quote = world.quote()
    r = world.airline.request_booking(world.alice, world.conv, quote.data["quote_id"])
    assert r.ok and r.cards[0]["state"]["status"] == "quoted"
    message = world.done(quote.cards + r.cards)
    states = [c["state"] for c in message["cards"]]
    assert [c["type"] for c in message["cards"]] == ["quote", "booking_request"]
    assert states[0] == states[1] and states[0]["bookable"]  # one message, one nonce
    assert world.sql("select count(*) from quote_cards") == [(1,)]


def test_request_booking_refusals(world):

    other = world.store.create_conversation(world.alice)["id"]
    for user, conv, qid in ((world.bob, world.bob_conv, quote_id), (world.bob, world.conv, quote_id),

        assert r.code == "not_found" and r.cards == () and r.data == {"quote_id": qid}

    world.airline.book(world.alice, quote_id, nonce)

    assert booked.code == "already_booked" and booked.cards[0]["type"] == "ticket"
    assert booked.data["ticket_id"] == booked.cards[0]["id"]

def test_request_booking_on_an_expired_quote_gives_a_notice_and_closes_it(world):
    quote_id, _ = world.presented()
    world.clock.advance(minutes=15)
    r = world.airline.request_booking(world.alice, world.conv, quote_id)
    assert r.code == "quote_expired"
    assert r.cards == ({"type": "notice", "code": "quote_expired",
                        "message": "This quote has expired. Please ask for a new quote."},)
    assert_card(r.cards[0], SCHEMAS)
    assert world.status(quote_id) == "expired"


# --- post_assistant_message / messages ---------------------------------------------------------
def test_done_presents_the_quote_and_only_then_gives_a_nonce(world):
    quote = world.quote()
    quote_id = quote.data["quote_id"]
    assert world.status(quote_id) == "quoted"
    world.clock.advance(seconds=4)
    message = world.done(quote.cards, text="The cheapest route is below.")
    assert_message(message, SCHEMAS)
    assert message["role"] == "assistant" and message["created_at"] == "2026-11-23T08:00:04Z"
    card = message["cards"][0]
    assert card["state"]["status"] == "presented" and card["state"]["bookable"] is True
    assert card["state"]["nonce"].startswith("n_") and card["state"]["ticket_id"] is None
    assert {k: v for k, v in card.items() if k != "state"} == \
           {k: v for k, v in quote.cards[0].items() if k != "state"}
    assert world.sql("select status, presented_at from quotes") == [("presented", "2026-11-23T08:00:04Z")]
    # the nonce is not in app.db
    dump = json.dumps(world.sql("select * from messages") + world.sql("select * from quote_cards")
                      + world.sql("select * from quotes"))
    assert card["state"]["nonce"] not in dump


def test_messages_view_reflects_the_current_server_state(world):
    quote = world.quote()
    quote_id = quote.data["quote_id"]
    first = world.done(quote.cards)
    second = world.done(world.airline.request_booking(world.alice, world.conv, quote_id).cards)
    n1, n2 = first["cards"][0]["state"]["nonce"], second["cards"][0]["state"]["nonce"]
    assert n1 != n2  # bound to the message the card is in

    view = world.airline.messages(world.alice, world.conv)
    assert [m["id"] for m in view] == [first["id"], second["id"]]
    assert [m["cards"][0]["state"]["nonce"] for m in view] == [n1, n2]  # stable across reloads
    for m in view:
        assert_message(m, SCHEMAS)

    out = world.airline.book(world.alice, quote_id, n2)
    view = world.airline.messages(world.alice, world.conv)
    booked = {"status": "booked", "bookable": False, "nonce": None, "ticket_id": out["ticket"]["id"]}
    assert [m["cards"][0]["state"] for m in view[:2]] == [booked, booked]
    assert view[2] == out["message"] and view[2]["role"] == "system"
    for m in view:
        assert_message(m, SCHEMAS)


def test_quote_cards_are_rendered_from_the_quote_not_from_what_was_posted(world):
    quote = world.quote()
    forged = {**quote.cards[0], "price_display": "$0.01", "price": "0.01", "destination": "Paris",
              "state": {"status": "presented", "bookable": True, "nonce": "n_forged", "ticket_id": None}}
    message = world.done([forged])
    assert message["cards"][0]["price_display"] == "$16.90" and message["cards"][0]["destination"] == "D"
    assert message["cards"][0]["state"]["nonce"] != "n_forged"
    assert world.sql("select cards from messages") == [(json.dumps(

def test_other_cards_and_guard_problems_are_stored_as_given(world):

    assert world.store.list_messages(world.conv)[0]["guard_problems"] == [{"kind": "number", "value": "42"}]


def test_done_refuses_foreign_conversations_and_foreign_quotes(world):
    quote = world.quote()
    with pytest.raises(NotFound):
        world.airline.post_assistant_message(world.bob, world.conv, "x", quote.cards)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):  # Alice's quote card in Bob's conversation
        world.airline.post_assistant_message(world.bob, world.bob_conv, "x", quote.cards)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        world.done([{"type": "quote", "id": "q_missing"}])
    assert world.sql("select count(*) from messages") == [(0,)]  # rolled back with the message
    assert world.status(quote.data["quote_id"]) == "quoted"
    with pytest.raises(NotFound):

def test_done_after_expiry_does_not_present(world):

def test_a_presented_quote_shows_as_expired_on_reload_without_being_touched(world):

    world.clock.advance(minutes=14, seconds=59)
    assert world.airline.messages(world.alice, world.conv)[0]["cards"][0]["state"]["bookable"] is True

    assert world.airline.get_quote(world.alice, quote_id)["state"]["status"] == "expired"


# --- tickets -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def booked(world, origin, destination, user=None, conv=None):
    quote_id, nonce = world.presented(origin, destination, user, conv)
    return world.airline.book(user or world.alice, quote_id, nonce)["ticket"]


def test_tickets_newest_first_and_only_mine(world):
    t1 = booked(world, "A", "D")
    world.clock.advance(minutes=1)
    t2 = booked(world, "B", "C")
    booked(world, "A", "B", world.bob, world.bob_conv)
    mine = world.airline.tickets(world.alice)
    assert [t["id"] for t in mine] == [t2["id"], t1["id"]]
    for card in mine:
        assert_card(card, SCHEMAS)
    assert mine[1] == t1 and t1["booked_at"] == "2026-11-23T08:00:00Z"
    assert len(world.airline.tickets(world.bob)) == 1


def test_list_tickets_counts_and_filters(world):
    t1 = booked(world, "A", "D")  # A H1 H3 H4 D
    world.clock.advance(minutes=60)
    t2 = booked(world, "B", "C")  # B H1 H3 C
    booked(world, "A", "B", world.bob, world.bob_conv)

    everything = world.airline.list_tickets(world.alice)
    assert everything.ok and everything.cards[0]["type"] == "ticket_list"
    assert_card(everything.cards[0], SCHEMAS)
    assert everything.data == {"count": 2, "filter": {}, "tickets": [t2, t1]}

    def ids(**filter_):
        r = world.airline.list_tickets(world.alice, **filter_)
        assert r.ok and r.cards[0]["count"] == len(r.cards[0]["tickets"]) == r.data["count"]
        assert r.cards[0]["filter"] == {k: str(v) for k, v in filter_.items()}
        assert_card(r.cards[0], SCHEMAS)
        return [t["id"] for t in r.cards[0]["tickets"]]

    assert ids(city="d") == [t1["id"]]  # destination, case-insensitive
    assert ids(city="H3") == [t2["id"], t1["id"]]  # a transfer city
    assert ids(city="Paris") == []
    assert ids(ticket_id=t1["id"]) == [t1["id"]]
    assert ids(ticket_id="t_missing") == []
    assert ids(booked_after="2026-11-23T09:00:00Z") == [t2["id"]]  # inclusive
    assert ids(booked_before="2026-11-23T09:00:00Z") == [t1["id"]]  # exclusive
    assert ids(booked_after="2026-11-23", booked_before="2026-11-24") == [t2["id"], t1["id"]]
    assert ids(booked_after="2026-11-24") == []
    assert ids(booked_after="2026-11-23T16:30:00+08:00") == [t2["id"]]
    assert ids(city="h1", booked_before="2026-11-23T08:30:00") == [t1["id"]]


def test_list_tickets_rejects_a_bad_time(world):
    r = world.airline.list_tickets(world.alice, booked_after="last week")
    assert r.code == "bad_request" and r.cards == () and "last week" in r.data["message"]


def test_list_tickets_when_there_are_none(world):
    r = world.airline.list_tickets(world.alice)
    assert r.data == {"count": 0, "filter": {}, "tickets": []} and world.airline.tickets(world.alice) == []

import json

                                          "nearest": unserved.cards[0]["nearest"]}


def test_ambiguous_city_in_a_quote_on_the_real_db(real):
    r = real.airline.quote_route(real.alice, real.conv, "san jose", "Lima")
    assert r.code == "ambiguous_city" and r.cards[0]["type"] == "ambiguous_city"
    assert [c["city"] for c in r.cards[0]["candidates"]] == ["San Jose", "San José"]
    exact = real.airline.quote_route(real.alice, real.conv, "San Jose", "Lima")
    assert exact.ok and exact.data["similar_names"] == {"San Jose": ["San José"]}


def test_the_contract_example_route_on_the_real_db(real):
    """Guangzhou -> Lima: same route and display values as the contract fixtures."""
    r = real.airline.quote_route(real.alice, real.conv, "Guangzhou", "Lima")
    fixture = json.loads((FIXTURES / "conversation.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["messages"][1]["cards"][0]
    card = r.cards[0]
    for key in ("type", "origin", "destination", "transfers", "distance_display", "price_display"):
        assert card[key] == fixture[key], key

           [(l["from"], l["to"], l["distance_display"]) for l in fixture["legs"]]

    assert trace["note"] == example["note"]


def test_quote_route_checks_the_conversation_owner(world):

def test_tools_raise_when_locations_db_is_broken(world):

# --- trace -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_trace_shows_sources_coordinates_and_the_core_formula(world):

def test_trace_is_only_for_the_owner(world):

def test_fractional_coordinates_are_numbers_in_the_trace(world):

def test_request_booking_returns_a_confirm_card_without_a_nonce(world):
    quote_id, _ = world.presented()
    r = world.airline.request_booking(world.alice, world.conv, quote_id)
    assert r.ok and r.data["quote_id"] == quote_id and r.data["status"] == "presented"
    card = r.cards[0]
    assert_card(card, SCHEMAS)
    assert card["type"] == "booking_request" and card["id"] == quote_id
    assert card["state"] == {"status": "presented", "bookable": False, "nonce": None, "ticket_id": None}
    quote_card = world.airline.get_quote(world.alice, quote_id)
    assert {k: v for k, v in card.items() if k not in ("type", "state")} == \
           {k: v for k, v in quote_card.items() if k not in ("type", "state")}
    no_nonce_anywhere(r)
    assert world.ticket_count() == 0 and world.status(quote_id) == "presented"


def test_request_booking_in_the_same_turn_as_the_quote(world):
    quote = world.quote()
    r = world.airline.request_booking(world.alice, world.conv, quote.data["quote_id"])
    assert r.ok and r.cards[0]["state"]["status"] == "quoted"
    message = world.done(quote.cards + r.cards)
    states = [c["state"] for c in message["cards"]]
    assert [c["type"] for c in message["cards"]] == ["quote", "booking_request"]
    assert states[0] == states[1] and states[0]["bookable"]  # one message, one nonce
    assert world.sql("select count(*) from quote_cards") == [(1,)]


def test_request_booking_refusals(world):
    quote_id, nonce = world.presented()
    other = world.store.create_conversation(world.alice)["id"]
    for user, conv, qid in ((world.bob, world.bob_conv, quote_id), (world.bob, world.conv, quote_id),
                            (world.alice, other, quote_id), (world.alice, world.conv, "q_missing")):
        r = world.airline.request_booking(user, conv, qid)
        assert r.code == "not_found" and r.cards == () and r.data == {"quote_id": qid}

    world.airline.book(world.alice, quote_id, nonce)

    assert booked.code == "already_booked" and booked.cards[0]["type"] == "ticket"
    assert booked.data["ticket_id"] == booked.cards[0]["id"]
    assert_card(booked.cards[0], SCHEMAS)
    assert world.ticket_count() == 1


def test_request_booking_on_an_expired_quote_gives_a_notice_and_closes_it(world):
    quote_id, _ = world.presented()
    world.clock.advance(minutes=15)
    r = world.airline.request_booking(world.alice, world.conv, quote_id)
    assert r.code == "quote_expired"
    assert r.cards == ({"type": "notice", "code": "quote_expired",
                        "message": "This quote has expired. Please ask for a new quote."},)
    assert_card(r.cards[0], SCHEMAS)
    assert world.status(quote_id) == "expired"


# --- post_assistant_message / messages ---------------------------------------------------------
def test_done_presents_the_quote_and_only_then_gives_a_nonce(world):
    quote = world.quote()
    quote_id = quote.data["quote_id"]
    assert world.status(quote_id) == "quoted"
    world.clock.advance(seconds=4)
    message = world.done(quote.cards, text="The cheapest route is below.")
    assert_message(message, SCHEMAS)
    assert message["role"] == "assistant" and message["created_at"] == "2026-11-23T08:00:04Z"
    card = message["cards"][0]
    assert card["state"]["status"] == "presented" and card["state"]["bookable"] is True
    assert card["state"]["nonce"].startswith("n_") and card["state"]["ticket_id"] is None
    assert {k: v for k, v in card.items() if k != "state"} == \
           {k: v for k, v in quote.cards[0].items() if k != "state"}
    assert world.sql("select status, presented_at from quotes") == [("presented", "2026-11-23T08:00:04Z")]
    # the nonce is not in app.db
    dump = json.dumps(world.sql("select * from messages") + world.sql("select * from quote_cards")
                      + world.sql("select * from quotes"))
    assert card["state"]["nonce"] not in dump


def test_messages_view_reflects_the_current_server_state(world):
    quote = world.quote()
    quote_id = quote.data["quote_id"]
    first = world.done(quote.cards)
    second = world.done(world.airline.request_booking(world.alice, world.conv, quote_id).cards)
    n1, n2 = first["cards"][0]["state"]["nonce"], second["cards"][0]["state"]["nonce"]
    assert n1 != n2  # bound to the message the card is in

    view = world.airline.messages(world.alice, world.conv)
    assert [m["id"] for m in view] == [first["id"], second["id"]]
    assert [m["cards"][0]["state"]["nonce"] for m in view] == [n1, n2]  # stable across reloads
    for m in view:
        assert_message(m, SCHEMAS)

    out = world.airline.book(world.alice, quote_id, n2)
    view = world.airline.messages(world.alice, world.conv)
    booked = {"status": "booked", "bookable": False, "nonce": None, "ticket_id": out["ticket"]["id"]}
    assert [m["cards"][0]["state"] for m in view[:2]] == [booked, booked]
    assert view[2] == out["message"] and view[2]["role"] == "system"
    for m in view:
        assert_message(m, SCHEMAS)


def test_quote_cards_are_rendered_from_the_quote_not_from_what_was_posted(world):
    quote = world.quote()
    forged = {**quote.cards[0], "price_display": "$0.01", "price": "0.01", "destination": "Paris",
              "state": {"status": "presented", "bookable": True, "nonce": "n_forged", "ticket_id": None}}
    message = world.done([forged])
    assert message["cards"][0]["price_display"] == "$16.90" and message["cards"][0]["destination"] == "D"
    assert message["cards"][0]["state"]["nonce"] != "n_forged"
    assert world.sql("select cards from messages") == [(json.dumps(
        [{"type": "quote", "id": quote.data["quote_id"]}], separators=(",", ":")),)]


def test_other_cards_and_guard_problems_are_stored_as_given(world):

    assert world.store.list_messages(world.conv)[0]["guard_problems"] == [{"kind": "number", "value": "42"}]


def test_done_refuses_foreign_conversations_and_foreign_quotes(world):
    quote = world.quote()
    with pytest.raises(NotFound):
        world.airline.post_assistant_message(world.bob, world.conv, "x", quote.cards)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):  # Alice's quote card in Bob's conversation
        world.airline.post_assistant_message(world.bob, world.bob_conv, "x", quote.cards)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):

def test_a_presented_quote_shows_as_expired_on_reload_without_being_touched(world):

def booked(world, origin, destination, user=None, conv=None):
    quote_id, nonce = world.presented(origin, destination, user, conv)
    return world.airline.book(user or world.alice, quote_id, nonce)["ticket"]


def test_tickets_newest_first_and_only_mine(world):
    t1 = booked(world, "A", "D")
    world.clock.advance(minutes=1)
    t2 = booked(world, "B", "C")
    booked(world, "A", "B", world.bob, world.bob_conv)
    mine = world.airline.tickets(world.alice)
    assert [t["id"] for t in mine] == [t2["id"], t1["id"]]
    for card in mine:
        assert_card(card, SCHEMAS)
    assert mine[1] == t1 and t1["booked_at"] == "2026-11-23T08:00:00Z"
    assert len(world.airline.tickets(world.bob)) == 1


def test_list_tickets_counts_and_filters(world):
    t1 = booked(world, "A", "D")  # A H1 H3 H4 D
    world.clock.advance(minutes=60)
    t2 = booked(world, "B", "C")  # B H1 H3 C
    booked(world, "A", "B", world.bob, world.bob_conv)

    everything = world.airline.list_tickets(world.alice)
    assert everything.ok and everything.cards[0]["type"] == "ticket_list"
    assert_card(everything.cards[0], SCHEMAS)
    assert everything.data == {"count": 2, "filter": {}, "tickets": [t2, t1]}

    def ids(**filter_):
        r = world.airline.list_tickets(world.alice, **filter_)
        assert r.ok and r.cards[0]["count"] == len(r.cards[0]["tickets"]) == r.data["count"]
        assert r.cards[0]["filter"] == {k: str(v) for k, v in filter_.items()}
        assert_card(r.cards[0], SCHEMAS)
        return [t["id"] for t in r.cards[0]["tickets"]]

    assert ids(city="d") == [t1["id"]]  # destination, case-insensitive
    assert ids(city="H3") == [t2["id"], t1["id"]]  # a transfer city
    assert ids(city="Paris") == []
    assert ids(ticket_id=t1["id"]) == [t1["id"]]
    assert ids(ticket_id="t_missing") == []
    assert ids(booked_after="2026-11-23T09:00:00Z") == [t2["id"]]  # inclusive
    assert ids(booked_before="2026-11-23T09:00:00Z") == [t1["id"]]  # exclusive
    assert ids(booked_after="2026-11-23", booked_before="2026-11-24") == [t2["id"], t1["id"]]
    assert ids(booked_after="2026-11-24") == []
    assert ids(booked_after="2026-11-23T16:30:00+08:00") == [t2["id"]]
    assert ids(city="h1", booked_before="2026-11-23T08:30:00") == [t1["id"]]
